summary.title: Executive Summary — The Week in Numbers

blocks.label: The week in one line
blocks.text: Nifty 50 -3.11% · FPI equity -₹27,962 Cr · USD/INR 95.93 · Brent -1.93% · breadth mixed.
FPIs: a net equity outflow of ₹27,962 Cr across 4 NSDL reporting days (0 of 4 positive); debt -₹8,630 Cr.
USD/INR 95.93 (-0.24%, rupee stronger); Brent $102.31 (-1.93%); India 10-year 7.18%; US 10-year 5.24% (+5 bp).
Nifty 50 -3.11% to 22,421.95, Midcap 150 -3.54%, Smallcap 250 -3.14% in the week to 1 Oct.

Of 1,562 coded names in the scan, 276 rose and 1,282 fell on the week (median -3.17%). Breadth regime: **mixed**, with 32.1% above the 50-DMA and 47.8% above the 200-DMA (-22.3 and -13.8 points over four weeks).
Stage 2 by calculation (all 7 template checks): 329 names, 40 entered and 90 left since 25 Sep. The provider's Stage 2 list (701 names) was not updated this week (the list on file is dated 13 Sep).

SwingEdge sub-sector trackers: 3 of 32 trackers rose. Led by Aerospace Components & Machining (+6.06%), Optical Fibre & Telecom Gear (+3.92%), AI Data Centre (+2.67%); lagged by Hospitals (-6.31%), Wind (-5.59%), Sugar & Ethanol (-5.41%). The equal-weight market line: -2.71%.

blocks.label: How this report is built
blocks.text: Built automatically by `tools/auto_weekly.py` from data the evening pull already has: the screener.in scan, NSE's index file, NSDL's FPI Monitor, RBI's current rates, Yahoo closes, and SwingEdge's own breadth, Stage 2 and tracker files. No model writes any of it: each sentence is a template filled with the week's numbers. Not collected: DII daily flows and derivatives positioning (no keyless source). Facts only; nothing here rates a stock.
